title: NEET UG re-test highlights: 9 fake candidates arrested in Bihar for allegedly impersonating students
description: NEET UG re-exam highlights: The medical entrance re-test concluded for 22.79 lakh candidates. Students said biology was easiest while physics was toughest. A student reportedly died by suicide in Haryana ahead of the exam. The NTA said no paper leaks have been reported so far.
